bc_skaha_bluffs.name: Skaha Bluffs
bc_skaha_bluffs.note: Tourism Penticton: dry and warm March to October; other guides say March-November with Apr/May/Sep/Oct the sweet spot, summer hot (shade walls); took shared Mar-Oct window.

ny_adirondacks.name: Adirondacks
ny_adirondacks.note: Only one month-naming source found (April to mid-October); others season words only; system also large and varied (peregrine closures, high peaks vs low crags). Excluded all.

wa_icicle_creek.name: Icicle Creek
wa_icicle_creek.note: Sources give only season words (spring through fall; shoulder seasons; mid-Sep-Oct prime); one travel guide says May-Oct; no reliable month-naming guidebook/agency source confirmed.

co_durango.name: Durango
co_durango.note: Sources say mostly spring to fall, summer hot, winter cold, no months named; system also spans limestone sport, ice park (Cascade Canyon) and X Rock far west, so no single window.
